help.title: One life. One big dream.
steps: Each turn is one year, from age 11 to 36.
Divide your monthly money into jars. Needs come first.
Spend your little-joys jar in the shop, if you like.
Make choices on the cards. Press Why? to see the reason.
Ammamma's glasses reveal tricky words. Documents hide red flags: tap them.
At the end, replay one decision in a Parallel Life.

intro.child: Pocket money, a tin box and a big fair in town. Small choices now become habits for life.
intro.teen: Phones, friends with shortcuts and your first earnings. The choice after Class 12 is coming.
intro.young: Your first payslip, your first loan offers, and a bank that finally knows your name.
intro.adult: Weddings, storms and markets that fall. Insurance and an emergency fund decide the damage.
intro.settle: The dream is close. Read every paper twice and plan for the years after 36.

placeInfo.home: Ammamma's kitchen smells of rasam. Big family decisions happen here.
placeInfo.school: Swapna madam turns every problem into a sum. Come here to learn how money grows.
placeInfo.bank: Kavitha akka runs the bank counter. Savings accounts, FDs, RDs and fair loans live here.
placeInfo.hospital: When illness strikes, insurance and an emergency fund decide how big the bill feels.
placeInfo.shop: Anjamma aunty's khata remembers everything. Spend your little-joys jar here.
placeInfo.sahukar: Narsaiah sahukar is polite, patient and very expensive: ₹2 per ₹100 per month.
placeInfo.post: The post office keeps safe schemes: savings, PPF and pensions for old age.
placeInfo.work: Earn here. Every hour of work has a price, and so does every hour you don't work.
placeInfo.panchayat: Land records and documents. Read every line before you sign anything.
placeInfo.square: Everyone meets at the banyan tree, including people with schemes that sound too good.
placeInfo.field: Nanna's cotton field. Rain, drought and crop insurance live here.
placeInfo.phone: Messages, banking and investing, in your pocket.
